title: refactor(devx): move the four inline ESLint rule plugins into a private workspace package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi97zYZvbkizsECxcnTpJKKpP)_
Fixes #26093
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The four inline rule plugins in `eslint.config.mjs` (slot-lookup, query-options, verify-stand-in, comment-swallow) move into a private workspace package, `packages/eslint-plugin` (`@objectstack/eslint-plugin`, `"private": true`, no build step). The root config imports it by relative path and keeps only configuration.

- **Plain ESM, not TypeScript.** `pnpm lint` loads the config with native `import`, and the repo's `engines` floor is Node 22.0; a `.ts` source would need Node 22.18 type stripping. `tsconfig.json` sets `allowJs` + `checkJs`, so `tsc` reads the rule sources too (JSDoc types; AST helpers are deliberately untyped, documented in each file).
- **Rule ids, messages and plugin namespaces are unchanged.** Each rule keeps its prefix (`slot-lookup/…` etc.), so the ratchet scripts and their rule-id / message matching see the same thing.
- **Configuration stays in the config.** `SLOT_LOOKUPS`, `UNCONTRACTED_SLOTS` and `VERIFY_STAND_IN_CHECKS` stay in `eslint.config.mjs` (the slot-lookup selectors read the first two, and both the message text and `check:verify-stand-in` say they live there). Those two rules now get the lists as **required** options: a config that drops them fails ESLint's schema validation instead of running against an empty set (pinned in the tests).
- **The export surface of `eslint.config.mjs` is kept.** Every named export the scripts import is still exported (re-exported from the package). The only one dropped is `COMMENT_SWALLOW_CASES`, which nothing imported. It moved into the tests.
- **The self-assert block is now tests.** `assertCommentSwallow()` and its 17 pinned cases became `test/comment-swallow.test.ts`, along with the "files glob must cover plain JS" assertion.
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: only the new importer (+18 lines, from `pnpm install`). No new resolutions. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` untouched (`packages/*` glob). No baseline file changed.

## Behaviour preserved: before / after

Before = `origin/main` d1ea2363, after = head 4d18cf1c, same worktree:

| reading | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm lint` (exact root script) | exit 0, no output | exit 0, no output; byte-identical (diff empty apart from the worktree path in the pnpm banner) |
| `pnpm check:slot-lookup` | 100 unswept sites in 25 files; self-test 5 shapes / 8 canonical | identical output (diff empty) |
| `pnpm check:query-options-erasure` | 50 non-test sites in 15 files; test surface 236 in 47 | identical output (diff empty) |
| `pnpm check:verify-stand-in` | 2 guarded, 18 exempt, 10 call sites, 0 asserted | identical output (diff empty) |

`pnpm lint` has nothing to report on either side, so the empty diff is weak evidence by itself. The three ratchets are the strong reading: they import this config, lift its grandfathering, and count each rule's reports per file, and their self-tests drive the live rules through the config ("reports all 5 erasure shapes"). Their outputs are byte-identical before and after.

## Comments: moved, not rewritten (#25919 ruling A)

Of the 635 non-blank lines removed from `eslint.config.mjs`, 585 appear verbatim in the package. Each plugin file has a short header saying the history moved from the config, so "above" / "below" in it refer to that file. The other 50 lines are accounted for:
- rule code lines that gained a JSDoc type, an `export`, or read options instead of the config constants;
- the `assertCommentSwallow()` function body, rewritten as vitest assertions;
- two pointers that named `assertCommentSwallow` (one in the package, one left in the config) now point at the test;
- the cases docblock, whose "runs where the config loads" sentence is no longer true.

Config-block comments that justify configuration (scope, ignores, the lists) stay where they were. The query-options block's "dedicated plugin rule, not selectors" + known-residual paragraphs moved, since they describe the rule. Three new one-line pointers name the rule file.

## Acceptance

- [x] `pnpm lint` identical before/after: 0 errors, same (empty) warning set. Table above.
- [ ] `wc -l eslint.config.mjs` under about 400: **649** (was 1,271). Deviation, see below.
- [x] Tests run in the lane `packages/lint` runs in. `scripts/partition-test-shards.mjs` over `turbo ls --affected` puts `@objectstack/eslint-plugin` on Test Core shard 1/8. Locally: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/eslint-plugin test` gives 4 files, 73 tests, all pass.
- [x] `pnpm typecheck` covers the new package. `turbo run typecheck --filter=@objectstack/eslint-plugin` runs `tsc --noEmit` with exit 0. `--listFiles` shows all 5 `src/*.mjs`, all 5 `test/*.ts` and `vitest.config.ts`. `check:type-check-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt` are green.

### Why 649 and not about 400

The card's estimate takes 1,271 minus the "906 lines of plugins". But lines 1–120 of the old file are the lint-script header (`--stack-size` rationale, ~85 lines) and the subpath / defineX constants, and several constants in the 1–906 range are configuration that has to stay (slot lists, both baselines, `QUERY_OPTIONS_TEST_GLOBS`, `VERIFY_STAND_IN_CHECKS`, the rule ids). What remains is 225 code lines and 402 comment lines. All of those comments explain configuration, not rule history. Under ruling A ("存量不横扫") and the dispatch's "其它注释不改", getting to ~400 would mean sweeping them. That is not done here. If the seat wants the number, it is a separate comment-budget decision.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at 4d18cf1c: 68 families. Each was run on that head, with its exit captured before any pipe. All 68 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Build-reading gates (`check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`) ran after a full `pnpm build` (119/119 tasks). The plugin-teardown self-test ran after `git fetch --unshallow`.

The first run had two reds, both from one string: a moved comment-swallow case contains the example line ` * import { createHonoApp } from "@objectstack/hono";`. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:test-source-alias` scan test source text and read that string as an undeclared workspace import. The test now splits the specifier across a `+` (the runtime string is byte-identical; the original case list already split `/a*` + `/` the same way). Fixed in 4d18cf1c.

## Acceptance notes

- **Gate selection after this move (finding, not fixed here: outside the file surface).** `scripts/ci/select-gate-families.sh` runs the `slot_lookup` and `query_options_erasure` families for a `packages/*` path only when it is TS source (`is_ts_source`). Before, these rules lived in `eslint.config.mjs`, a root-config path that runs every family. Now they live in `packages/eslint-plugin/src/*.mjs`, so a later PR that edits only a rule file would skip both ratchet re-measures in CI. Their CI coverage would then be `pnpm lint` (always runs) and the package's own RuleTester suite in Test Core. This PR itself touches `eslint.config.mjs`, so every family runs on it. Suggested fix for the seat to file: add `packages/eslint-plugin/*` to those two families' trigger set.
- `@objectstack/eslint-plugin` is private and has no `dist`; it ships nothing, hence `skip-changeset`.
